searchItems.title: fix: match sessions to their workspace the way Claude Code names folders
searchItems.body:
## What this fixes

Closes #24

Two ways the office lost or gained sessions.

**1. Non-ASCII workspace paths never matched.** `workspace.slug()` lowercased before substituting:

```python
re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", str(path).lower())
```

In Python `"İ".lower()` is two characters (`i` + U+0307), so one character spent two dashes: `C:\Users\İsmail\shop` became `c--users-i-smail-shop`, while Claude Code made `c--users--smail-shop`. The prefix never matched and the office showed no sessions at all.

Fixed by substituting before lowercasing. Characters outside the BMP are replaced per UTF-16 code u
